$comment-dependencies: Deliberately empty. The only native dependency is MIT krb5, which is a system library discovered through pkg-config rather than a vcpkg port: sealing is done by the negotiated GSS security context, so there is no TLS library here and none may be added for that purpose (constitution, Security & Data-Handling Constraints). The manifest exists because the DuckDB extension CI tooling expects one.
name: xmla-extension
description: DuckDB extension for SQL Server Analysis Services over the native XMLA/TCP binding
